generations.conceptPrompt: A 1989 hand-held police scanner receiver an Eastern-bloc black-market fence would sell: an upright black plastic pocket set with a short stub antenna on top, a small LCD window and keypad on the front and a speaker grille below. Plain black rectangular body, a short antenna, a rectangular LCD strip, two chunky ribbed knobs and a row of four push buttons, a speaker grille below. Solid chunky forms, separate distinct parts, no thin floating details, a clear grip area, a flat stable side to rest on. Single object, orthographic-style three-quarter product shot from slightly above, the whole object in frame, plain flat light grey background, soft even studio light, no hands, no stand, no text, no logos, no watermark.
